proyectosDescripcion: Selected personal projects that reinforce my platform, automation, and infrastructure profile:
descripcion: Platform / DevOps / SRE engineer with 9+ years across software and infrastructure. Experienced designing delivery platforms (CI/CD, GitOps, Kubernetes, service mesh) and operating high-criticality production environments. Career path from full-stack development to cloud and platform engineering: automation, IaC (Terraform/Terragrunt), observability, and developer experience. Focused on technical ownership, standardization, and reliable paths to production.

items: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, ECS, EKS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, Route53, SNS, CloudWatch, Glue, IAM)

logros: Design and maintain the delivery platform in a high-throughput fintech environment (thousands of production changes), focusing on reusable GitHub Actions, GitOps (ArgoCD/Kubernetes), and a reliable path to production.
Improved shared pipelines for Java and Go applications: performance, Sonar integration, Signadot testing sandboxes, and unit tests for the GitHub Actions themselves.

Owned and executed two Istio routing migrations across ~300 repositories - from a flat VirtualGateway to VirtualService model to a hierarchical gateway + root VirtualService + delegated leafs - with zero downtime.
Redesigned canary promotion metrics to use canary-scoped signals instead of aggregate production error rates, preventing stalled rollouts when baseline traffic was already degraded.

Manage Datadog alerts for pipelines and Kubernetes infrastructure components as code (Git + Terraform), and publish standards/docs that help developers resolve delivery issues without leaving their code focus.
Cloud infrastructure consultant for client accounts (banking proxies and consumer tech), owning IaC and delivery work across AWS and Azure.

Designed and implemented infrastructure with Terraform/Terragrunt: legacy module migrations, Terraform import/centralization into a monorepo, and targeted platform solutions for client-specific problems.
Delivered workload migrations: EC2+Docker Compose to ECS, ECS modernizations, serverless (Lambda + API Gateway), RDS, DNS to Route53, and Kubernetes cluster version upgrades on AWS and Azure.
Improved observability and operational response: Datadog monitors and a reusable CloudWatch to SNS to Lambda alerting path to Microsoft Teams across multiple applications.

Built CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps for Lambda, S3+CloudFront static apps, infra with Infracost, and a pipeline to ship Python code directly to AWS Glue; plus internal tooling to migrate/import infrastructure and streamline AWS CLI operations.
Started as a Scala developer and moved into DevOps on Payway: pipelines, delivery standards, and lower-environment operations on-prem for Scala and Next.js applications.
Owned and executed CI/CD migrations: Jenkins modernization (Git plugins), GitHub to Bitbucket, and consolidation of Bitbucket/GitHub/Jenkins pipelines onto GitLab CI.
Migrated workloads from Apache Mesos to Kubernetes and established a Terraform + Helm foundation to ship applications via GitOps (ArgoCD).
Standardized quality and branching: SonarQube across repositories and a GitHub Flow to GitFlow migration (pipelines, documentation, and team enablement).
Improved developer/QA experience with a tool to exercise cluster-running code from local machines and a Discord bot for common support questions.
Designed pipelines and tooling to configure Kong routing (API gateway used heavily on the project), enabling developers to manage routes without operational friction.
Built Java (Spring) backends for public-sector and payments clients (ANSES, Ministry of Production, AFIP, payment proxy) and Python services.
Developed ETLs with a custom Python tool; installed and configured Apache Druid and visualization dashboards (including Apache Superset).
Implemented Jenkins deployment pipelines and operated production EC2 instances running Docker Compose, monitoring host and application availability.
Delivered end-to-end features on the Swiss Medical platform (Java 1.6-1.8, Spring, JavaScript/Backbone, REST), including workflows with jBPM and Apache Camel.
Owned database migrations and related queries for those deliveries.
Contributed to the design and development of a middle manager component for the same platform.

proyectos.descripcion: DevOps remediation engine: FastAPI services/rules/consequences model, React/Vite admin UI, Dockerized delivery.
Reusable Terraform/Terragrunt modules: AWS (SNS to Teams alarms, Route53, IAM, Glue), ArgoCD, and kubeadm provisioning.
Self-managed Kubernetes (kubeadm/containerd/Flannel) via Terragrunt: bootstrap, declarative worker sync, and ArgoCD.
Ubuntu Server autoinstall USB (online/offline) with Docker/SSH/Git bootstrap for hands-off machine provisioning.
Cross-PC savegame sync: Go engine, web/desktop UI, Docker Compose, and SemVer releases via GitHub Actions.
YAML-driven SSH hop/tunnel orchestration, runnable with Docker/Python for internal network access.
